description: Defines a widget model for API usage data within the Thingsboard platform, including functions for testing widget applicability, preparing export info, updating from export info, and retrieving datasources.

methods.name: testWidget
methods.description: Checks if the widget's settings contain apiUsageDataKeys array to determine applicability.

methods.name: prepareExportInfo
methods.description: Prepares export information for the widget based on its dashboard and settings.

methods.name: updateFromExportInfo
methods.description: Updates widget settings from exported info, particularly the entity alias ID.

methods.name: datasources
methods.description: Returns the datasources associated with the widget, based on its settings.
